summary: No new grant path: setup-pause approvals reuse the existing request-only capability review + persist->recheck chain; the locked option set is honored (setup-pause prompts offer Allow-for-future/Deny only, never a one-time grant a dead run cannot use). A setup-specific fingerprint fence rejects stale approvals on both live and recovered decisions. Prompts route only to the authorized approver route. The one residual is a microsecond fence/grant TOCTOU (D-0046) whose worst case is a user-revocable durable grant after a concurrent job change — no privilege escalation, no data loss.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Non-atomic fence vs persistent grant on the recovery path — deferred D-0046 (user-revocable, cross-aggregate transaction needed).

residual_risks: D-0046: fence/grant atomicity — user-revocable durable grant in a concurrent-job-change TOCTOU window.
recommendation: Land; the sole security-relevant residual is bounded and user-revocable, tracked as D-0046.
